S1.query: single Product; SF1/SF10 are 5,000/50,000 key thresholds on frozen provsql_orders

S2.query: connected inner equijoin plus status grouping on frozen provsql_orders/provsql_lineitem; same thresholds; no nonce; the evaluation normalizer applies canonical typed-row ordering because this frozen query defines no total result order and therefore does not rely on returned row order

S3.query: one member_rank result column from final_v5_exposure_scale; four predicate fields plus base row produce exactly five dependency Facts per retained row

S4.query: four layers are fixed filter/projection, connected join, aggregate, root projection; outer query only projects and evaluation canonical typed-row ordering supplies deterministic comparison

S5.query: Direct uses SQL UNION DISTINCT; BDG uses execute_plan structured union; right branch is an exact half-size subset; evaluation canonical typed-row ordering is outside the measured query

S6.query: 100/10k/100k rows at x4/x16; x4 is exact leading projection of sixteen real fields; shared with Artifact
